verdict.rationale: Recurly's Dunning Management docs cover branded email campaigns, segmented targeting, retry timing, and final-state rules for failed payments (docs-5, docs-18, docs-19, docs-34), and the separate Recurly Engage product provides in-app payment-failure prompts and churn-risk scoring (docs-26, docs-27). However, in-app banners require a distinct add-on product (Engage) rather than being native to core dunning, and there is no explicit documentation of configurable 'grace period' settings or independent/hands-on confirmation that these rules work end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit grace-period configuration documentation, unified single-product delivery of email+banner+grace+final-state rules, and independent verification of dunning sequence behavior.
